compressed_research.topic_text:
Research 80 square meter apartment layout optimization (2 bedroom, 1 living room, LDK layout with open kitchen), fume/oil smoke management solutions for open kitchens, and material recommendations for warm natural wood style (原木风). 

Specifically investigate:
1. Spatial planning and LDK (Living, Dining, Kitchen) layout strategies for 80 sqm 2-bedroom apartments:
   - Kitchen-dining-living room integrated layout (LDK)
   - Open kitchen design options (island table combo, glass sliding partition/foldable door options where gas regulation requires, Golden Triangle kitchen work line)
   - Storage optimization strategies (entryway, living room, master bedroom, kitchen storage ratio)
2. Fume/oil smoke management in open kitchens: range hood airflow requirements (m³/min), static pressure, cooking habits adjustments, air circulation.
3. Eco-friendly materials and finishes for natural wood/warm style:
   - Wood flooring vs. wood-look tile (木纹砖) vs. SPC flooring (pros, cons, cost per sqm in China)
   - Eco-friendly board grades (ENF grade, E0, F4 star) and cabinet carcass/door materials (solid wood particle board, OSB/Reed board, PET door panels)
   - Wall finishes: Latex paint brands (Nippon, Dulux, Tikkurila) and low-VOC specifications
   - Soft fabrics: Linen, cotton-linen, chenille, technology cloth (科技布) characteristics for sofas and curtains.
